requirement: EPIC 2 Story 1 — add explicit Pattern and one-shot Delete pad modes that never trigger musical input, route valid pad actions to slot/row clearing, and provide temporary whole-slot Undo.
story: Net tracker: EPIC 2 #1 — Select/clear patterns or rows through explicit pad modes (High, Priority 4).

architecture.decision: Keep the existing instrument presentation mode (drums/bass) separate from pad ownership. usePatternBank owns the mutually-exclusive control mode, delete arming, and one undo snapshot because it already owns active/queued slots and atomic slot mutations. BeatPad receives the presentation mode plus padMode and routes Pattern/Delete taps to non-audio callbacks; the existing useLiveInput handlers are called only by normal Drums/Bass input.
alternatives: Expand Mode to include pattern/delete: rejected because transport, recording, bank selection, grid editing, and audio code all treat Mode as drums/bass presentation.
Put clear/undo state in App: rejected because slot mutation and active-slot invalidation would split across owners.
Use a confirmation dialog for delete: rejected because the locked story specifies one-shot armed delete with temporary Undo only for whole-slot clears.
tradeoffs: The mode is a focused presentation/control seam passed through App rather than a new Context/store.
Row clear has no snapshot; whole-slot clear replaces only the target slot and exposes one expiring snapshot for that slot.
Pattern selection keeps EPIC 1 stopped/playing timing through selectSlot; a queued choice remains visible and latest-wins.
seams: usePatternBank.clearActiveRow/clearSlot and undoLastClear are the only whole-slot/row mutation paths.
Any edit, selection, replacement, or mode cancellation invalidates the undo snapshot; the timeout is owned by the hook and cleaned up on unmount.
Keyboard pad mapping checks padMode before musical input; Escape cancels Pattern/Delete and releases any held instrument keys.

tasks.title: Add bank-owned control mode and clear/undo actions
tasks.intent: Extend usePatternBank and pure pattern helpers with explicit pad ownership, row/slot clear operations, and a single 15-second whole-slot undo snapshot.
constraints: Keep PatternSlot selection timing and global runtime banks intact.
Whole-slot clear must preserve runtime bank fields and restore only its original slot.
Row clear must not create undo.
tasks.acceptance: The bank exposes padMode, setPadMode, cancelPadMode, armDelete, clearActiveRow, clearSlot, undoLastClear, and undo state; clear actions are immutable, selection/edit/replacement invalidates stale undo, and the undo snapshot expires after 15 seconds.
tasks.result: Added PadMode ownership plus immutable clearBassRow/clearPattern helpers; usePatternBank now owns row/slot clear actions, a single 15-second slot snapshot, timeout cleanup, and undo restoration while preserving runtime banks and the active audio ref.

tasks.title: Route Pattern/Delete ownership through the visualizer and keyboard
tasks.intent: Make Pattern mode select slots 1–4 without audio, make Delete clear only its valid target then exit, and keep keyboard pad input inert while a control mode owns the pad.
constraints: Pattern mode ignores pads 4.5–7 and Delete acts on the active selection only.
Escape cancels any control mode and releases held musical input.
Do not mutate notes outside the active/target slot.
tasks.acceptance: Pointer and keyboard Pattern/Delete actions never call audio/recording; valid Pattern selection uses stopped/playing timing, Delete row/slot semantics are isolated, and Escape restores normal input.
tasks.result: BeatPad and VisualizerPad now route Pattern/Delete taps separately from musical callbacks; keyboard mapped pads are inert for control modes, Escape releases held input and cancels ownership, and lesson/mode transitions cancel control ownership.
evidence: source audit of BeatPad, App, VisualizerPad, and useKeyboardControls

tasks.title: Expose accessible rail, badge, and undo states
tasks.intent: Add icon-first Pattern/Delete controls in the rail, a matching visualizer ownership badge, and a non-color Undo affordance for whole-slot clears.
constraints: Keep Pattern/Transpose below Drums/Bass and above octave controls.
Every icon-only control needs accessible name, title/data-tip, and pressed state where applicable.
Delete auto-exits after action; Undo is available for 15 seconds and cancels on edit/switch.
Preserve layout stability and reduced-motion behavior.
tasks.acceptance: Users can discover and operate Pattern/Delete by keyboard/touch; mode ownership is visible in rail and visualizer heading; disabled/inert pad states are clear; Undo appears only after whole-slot clear and disappears on timeout/edit/switch.
tasks.visual: Run the app and inspect normal, Pattern, armed Delete, post-slot-clear Undo, queued selection, focus, and reduced-motion states.
tasks.result: Added icon-first Pattern and disabled-but-explained Transpose rail controls, a lower-right one-shot Delete button, visualizer ownership badges, inert-pad styling, and a non-color Undo toast that avoids covering Delete.
evidence: Browser screenshot: Pattern badge, active slot state, and control rail
Browser DOM checks for accessible labels, pressed states, and inert pad classes

tasks.title: Verify mode isolation and deletion acceptance
tasks.intent: Prove the complete story in the running app, including audio isolation, slot/row targeting, undo expiry/cancellation, and no console errors.
constraints: Use the running browser and existing local document flow.
Do not claim audio isolation without exercising Pattern/Delete while transport is playing.
tasks.acceptance: Pattern selection never sounds; non-slot pads are inert; Delete row clears only the requested active row; Pattern Delete clears only the selected slot; Undo restores that slot only, expires at 15 seconds, and is canceled by the first edit or switch; Escape restores musical input.
tasks.visual: Exercise stopped and playing Pattern selection, rapid queued choices, armed Delete row/slot clears, Undo restore/expiry/cancellation, Escape, keyboard inertness, focus states, and console errors.
tasks.result: Browser acceptance passed for stopped and playing flows: Pattern mode selected/queued slots without musical callbacks; pads 5–7 were inert; row Delete cleared only the active drum row and auto-exited; slot Delete cleared only slot 2; Undo restored slot 2 and disappeared on slot switch; Escape canceled Pattern mode; playback stopped cleanly with zero browser console errors.
evidence: Browser: Pattern badge and pads 5–7 marked inert
Browser: row delete step 1 changed true -> false and Delete exited
Browser: slot-2 clear showed Undo and restored step 1
Browser: playing Pattern mode showed active/queued slot state; inert Pad 5 did not change it
